title: Redline Water Rentals

services.name: Jet Ski Rental Pricing
services.desc: Perfect for extended lake trips. Tow from West Jordan to Wahweap or Bullfrog and enjoy the freedom of multi-day rentals. Ideal for summer vacations and reunions. Ride Utah’s bluest waters with flexible, multi-day jet ski rentals. Enjoy scenic rides, open water, and adventure. Pickup in West Jordan and tow straight to the Gorge. Just an hour from Salt Lake. Perfect for a quick weekend with beautiful mountain

blurb: We rent from Redline every year. We have always had a good experience. The machines are well maintained, Jake is always super flexible and willing to work with us, prices are great. We wouldn't go anywhere else.

quotes.text: We rent from Redline every year. We have always had a good experience. The machines are well maintained, Jake is always super flexible and willing to work with us, prices are great. We wouldn't go anywhere else. Highly recommend!

Pick up was quick and easy. We had a great time taking the rentals to Pineview. He even let us take a life jacket!! Return was also easy. Machines ran perfectly and were a lot of fun. Would rent here again and recommend.
We had the greatest time with the wave runners from Redline! They are super responsive and were able to answer all our questions. Would for sure go back in the future!
